title: NIST Dictionary of Algorithms and Data Structures: absolute

absolute performance guarantee
absolute performance guarantee
(definition)
Definition:
An
approximation algorithm
will return a solution at most a bounded amount more (or less, as appropriate) than the optimum.
See also
relative performance guarantee
.
Note:
